# What each benchmarked module runs on

`bench/modules/<m>.rb` exercises Ruby's `<m>`. This says whether rbgo serves
it from an external `go-ruby-<m>` library or from code in this repository —
which is what the per-library documentation sites claim, and what stops being
true when a module moves in-tree.

| Module | Runs on |
| --- | --- |
| abbrev | `github.com/go-ruby-abbrev/abbrev` |
| base64 | `github.com/go-ruby-base64/base64` |
| benchmark | `github.com/go-ruby-benchmark/benchmark` |

| cmath | `github.com/go-ruby-cmath/cmath` |
